notes: Volume is surname-first; names recorded as printed. House names printed before the name ('Gleadthorpe, Thompson Sidney') are split into house_name. Pages are directory scan page numbers (printed page = scan page - 31, e.g. scan 82 = printed p51). Several Park streets have no heading of their own in 1910-11 but appear as sub-headings inside another street's listing, recorded there with the sub-heading in `side`: Derby terrace, Barrack lane, Clinton terrace, Newcastle terrace (all inside Derby Road); Hermitage walk (inside Lenton Road). Derby Road whole listing transcribed (338 lines) incl. sub-terrace numbers, which are NOT Derby Road numbers. North Road and Hardwick Road headings are non-Park (West Bridgford / Sherwood) and not transcribed; a West Bridgford South Road also skipped. Lenton Avenue was on p122 and South Road starts p190, both a page before the plan estimate.
